subject: [PATCH v2 1/2] mm: refactor find_next_best_node to find_next_best_node_in

2026-09-12.patch_summary: This patch refactors the find_next_best_node function to find_next_best_node_in, which takes an explicit candidates nodemask instead of relying on N_MEMORY. This change enables building fallback lists with non-N_MEMORY candidates without changing any existing functionality. The new function is used in memory-tiers.c and page_alloc.c, where it replaces calls to the original function. The patch includes changes to internal.h, memory-tiers.c, and page_alloc.c, adding a new function signature and updating callers accordingly.
